description: Put 2 to 6 products side by side: kind, maker, size / mass / orbit, depth label, counts, the materials each uses (and which are shared or unique), the materials per part function, the spec rows they have in common, standards, organizations and what each does not publish. Use it to choose between comparable products or to see how a design differs ("CubeSat Kit structure vs EnduroSat structures"). It reads the same sourced records as get_product; open that for the quotes. Specs are aligned by label, so differences in wording show as separate rows.
name: compare_products
title: Compare products
